spans.s: (I)--the son of वेघवान् and father of तृण- bindhu. Br.
(II)--a वानर chieftain, and a son of श्वेत. Br.
(III)--one of the twenty Sutapa Gods. Br.

(IV)--one of the nine planets; son of Soma (moon) [त्विषि (वा। प्।)] and तारा wife of बृहस्पति; known as राजपुत्र; of brown colour; has a lustrous white chariot drawn by ten horses of different colours; originator of the हस्तिशास्त्र; and learned in the अर्थशास्त्र; got the kingdom on the earth;
